text: Show Me!, the picture book for children about sex by Will McBride and Helga Fleischhauer-Hardt, was banned in Australia in 1975 because of its explicit photographic depictions of nudity involving children. In New Zealand the English-language edition was ruled indecent by the Indecent Publications Tribunal in 1976, and the German-language edition was classified as objectionable in 1996. Booksellers in Massachusetts, New Hampshire, and Oklahoma were brought to court for selling it, but no court had ruled its sale illegal before the U.S. Supreme Court's decision. St. Martin's Press withdrew the book after a July 2 Supreme Court decision upheld a New York State law banning child pornography.
